author: kycrafft
body:
Raid: There are 2 teams, attackers and defenders. The attackers will have to destroy the monuments and the defenders will have to defend them. While void maps can and maps with a chunk of land (ex: fissura) can work, I imagine underground/tunnel maps could work as well.

Start of the game: Teams will be spawned in on separate sides of the map. Players will be able to choose a kit out of a few, just like in Axis. The attackers will have to rush the monuments while the defenders set up defenses and protect the monuments. The attacker kits should be a bit stronger than the defender kits but the defenders will have more blocks, ect to build defenses.

End of the game: The defenders will have to hold the attackers off for 10-15 minutes to win, but maybe more depending on the map. The attackers will have to break how ever many monuments there are to win.

Other notes: Defenders should not be able to go past the halfway point in the map Defenders should not be able to break their own monument (duh)

Only attackers can set off/be hurt by mines [pressure plates] (see below)

This can be done with no kits but it would be nice if the attackers dont get completely slaughtered every time they rush

KIT ITEMS THAT WOULD OTHERWISE BE DROPPED ON DEATH CANNOT BE PUT IN CHESTS.
 
Examples of kits:
Attackers:

 Rusher: Full leather except iron leggings, stone sword, diamond pickaxe, wood axe, 2 golden apples, 32 planks, bow and 10 arrows
Abilities, ect: Boots have feather falling 2, pickaxe has efficiency 2, speed 1
 
Tank:Full chain, stone sword, diamond pickaxe, 4 golden apples, 16 planks, bow and 24 arrows
Abilities, ect: Pants have blast protection 2  

Warrior: Full leather except iron chestplate, iron sword, diamond pickaxe, 3 golden apples, 16 planks, bow and 16 arrows
Abilities, ect: diamond pickaxe has efficiency 1

Defenders:
Guardian: Full leather except diamond chestplate, stone sword, stone axe and pick,  64 planks, 2 cobwebs, 2 golden apples
 Abilities, ect: Slowness 1, chestplate has protection 1

Sniper: Full leather, wood sword, bow and 1 arrow,  wooden axe and pick, 3 golden apples 32 planks, 16 glass and 2 stone pressure plates
Abilities, ect: Bow has power 1, punch and infinity, pressure plates are named ‘mine’ and explode when an attacker walks over them (no damage to blocks or other defenders)

Engineer: Full leather, stone sword, iron axe and pick, 2 golden apples, 64 planks, 4 cobwebs, and 3 stone pressure plates
Abilities, ect: pressure plates are mines    

TL;DR: 2 teams, attackers try to rush, defenders defend and there are kits.

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body: I love this idea. Sometimes in Nebula I feel more like defending than attacking, and it would be great to have a whole team defending. Awesome. It is hard of course to coordinate with your team as a defender, so I suggest that signs/holograms/books are placed at the monument giving tips on how to defend, OR the defenders are given a goal for their defense (Basically each map gives a goal, maybe in a loadout book that describes something like "build a wall around and snipe" and "don't cover the monument!" and other tips, something like that. Otherwise it'll be a cluster of trolls. This will also give more functionality to team picking, cause obviously donors can't predict which team will win, but now they can choose based on whether they want to defend or attack.
